name: Cherry Fritters
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ½ cup Maraschino cherries, cut in halves

steps: Mix corn-starch, flour, sugar, and salt.
Dilute with cold milk and add beaten yolks; then add gradually to scalded milk and cook fifteen minutes in double boiler.
Add cherries, pour into a buttered shallow tin, and cool.
Turn on a board, cut in squares, dip in flour, egg, and crumbs, fry in deep fat, and drain.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
